description: This header file declares API functions for managing WAN interfaces within a WAN manager component. It includes function prototypes for starting/stopping WAN state machines, activating, and deactivating WAN interfaces, along with detailed documentation for each API.

methods.name: WanMgr_StartWanVISM
methods.description: Initiates the WAN interface state machine to obtain a WAN lease on specified virtual interfaces, based on the interface index and selection status.

methods.name: WanMgr_StopWanVISM
methods.description: Stops the WAN interface state machine and resets its selection status.

methods.name: WanMgr_ActivateInterface
methods.description: Activates the specified WAN interface, configuring necessary routes, firewall, DNS, and transitions it to active state.

methods.name: WanMgr_DeactivateInterface
methods.description: Deactivates the specified WAN interface, removing configurations and moving it to standby state.
